Initial public release of smyx-snake-stomatitis-detection-analysis.

- Introduces high-definition, AI-powered visual detection of snake mouth rot (stomatitis) via enclosure camera images.
- Analyzes oral mucosa color, identifies pus points, ulcers, and necrotic tissue, and outputs comprehensive risk levels.
- Includes context-aware diagnostic exclusion (e.g., shedding, post-feeding, breeding injuries, temperature/humidity).
- Supports structured reporting, multi-level alert strategies, and strict user/open-id validation.
- Designed for use in reptile enclosures, vet clinics, and breeding farms; compatible with automated camera workflows.
